Content: part of the skull where the hair forms a whorl.
having a whorl on the head.
Gwápu si Pidru kay aluyúkan sa buna,
Pedro is handsome because he has a whorl on the front of his head.
topmost or innermost part of s.t.
Ang mga Magahat túa magpuyù sa kinaaluyukan sa lasang,
The Magahats live in the very center of the forest.
